heading: Shops, offices and storefronts.
lede: We paint businesses too, inside and out. Tell us your hours, and we'll plan the work around them.
includes: Filling holes and cracks before we paint
Priming stains and patches so they don't show through
stepsLede: A business can't close for a week. So we plan the work with you before we start.

steps.title: Walk through it together
steps.body: We look at the space with you and talk about your hours, your customers, and anything that can't be moved.

steps.title: A price in writing
steps.body: You get one price, in writing. Nothing starts until you say yes.

steps.title: One area at a time
steps.body: We work in sections and keep it tidy, so you can stay open where it makes sense.

steps.title: Clean up every day
steps.body: We clean up as we go and leave the space ready for business.

faq.question: Can we stay open while you paint?
faq.answer: Often, yes. We work one area at a time and keep it tidy. When we come look, we'll talk through what works for your business.

faq.question: What kinds of businesses do you paint?
faq.answer: Shops, storefronts, offices, break rooms, restrooms and hallways, inside and out.

faq.question: How does pricing work?
faq.answer: The same as for a home. We come look, and then you get one price in writing. It won't change unless you ask for more work.
